PASS on the fake backend; the gate exits 0. The card's helper MujocoDriver is right for this package: all five card entry symbols exist as Gymnasium task wrappers, and each wrapper is built around one MJCF scene. The package serves the card's models[0], the bimanual assembly scene, as a configuration-only MujocoDriver. cap.world.step.v1 takes action.ctrl bounded per actuator by the model's actuator_ctrlrange (46 actuators: 7 Panda motors and 16 Allegro position actuators per arm); cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults with mj_resetData + mj_forward; the world state is the bridge's time_ms/qpos/qvel/ctrl/tick/timestep_ms/seed. The scene and its include graph are read in place from the read-only clone at the pinned commit; neither the scene nor any upstream code is copied into the package or imported by it. The device is simulated R0: there is no hardware backend and no operator-required limit. Facts cite README.md:16-17 and the model/environment lines; no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings remain. The fake backend is a stand-in mujoco module (fake.py): it follows the scene's include graph and derives the actuator ranges, free-joint layout and qpos/qvel dimensions from the MJCF text, but it integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated joint toward its control target. MuJoCo was not installed or importable where the gate ran (no network, no pip), so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine, and the fake loads no mesh, texture, camera, sensor, contact or constraint. Warnings kept: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND because backends['fake'] is the package's stand-in module object, so the gate records no fake surface (the bridge-boundary checks still apply); G8.NO_UNIT x3 for the bridge-derived ticks, seed and action.ctrl inputs, which PLAYBOOK.md section 8 lists as expected for simulator families. NOT COVERED: the task wrapper layer around the scene - its sampled reset and domain randomization, its 23-value pose-plus-hand action per arm and the opspace conversion to actuator controls, its success predicate and its camera observations (render_spec defaults to 640x640 and image_obs defaults to true); the package serves the scene's raw ctrl vector and integration state. Also not covered: rendering; the fake does not implement mj_getState/mj_setState, so snapshot/restore on the fake uses the bridge's time/qpos/qvel/ctrl snapshot rather than MuJoCo's full integration-state snapshot. The card's other four scene task wrappers (hanoi, microwave, photograph, unlock iPad) are confirmed to exist but are not served. This package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by stays null); it was checked on the fake backend only, no hardware run was made, and no human review or test is claimed. The digest above is from the last gate run.
